subtitle: Arcade car combat
promotionalText: Chase, blast and wreck rival buggies. Play solo or battle up to 3 friends online with a room code.
description:
Floor it, lock on and blow the bad guys off the road.

Blast Buggies is a fast arcade car-combat game. Race down desert highways chasing outlaw cars, fire your guns, drop bombs, torch rivals with the flamethrower and launch a drone to hunt them down. Every wreck earns cash you spend on tougher, faster rides.

HOW YOU PLAY
- Street chases: track down the bad guys on each level before they get away.
- Arena battles: last car running wins in City, Town, Derby and Harbor arenas.
- Online VS: make a room, share the 4-letter code and battle up to 3 friends. No account, no chat.
- Simple controls: steer with one thumb, fire with four big arcade buttons.
- Switch camera views between top-down, behind the car and the windshield.

FREE TO PLAY
Levels 1-8 and the City and Town arenas are free. One optional Full Game purchase unlocks every level and arena and removes all ads.

FAIR ADS
No banners and no pop-up ads during play. After a round you can choose to watch a short video to double the cash you earned. It is always your choice.

Made by BIRCO, Inc.
